Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
